sources.label: AI was used in the making of these patches.
sources.author: byehi98
patch_list: Every "watch an ad" offer in Jetpack Joyride pays out instantly — the reward is claimed without playing any video, with no countdown and no network round trip, and the offer stays repeatable. Works offline.
Intercepts all in-app purchases and reports instant success to the game engine.

Stops the full-screen interstitial adverts Jetpack Joyride shows between runs. The game's own "no ad available" path is replayed, so the run continues immediately instead of freezing or waiting on a skipped advert.
